modos.descricao: Oponente perde 1 Rage e 1 Gnosis no combate

_metadata.texto_original: Opponents facing a character equipped with Gooshy Gooze lose 1 Rage and 1 Gnosis for the duration of the current combat. An opponent can never be reduced below 1 Rage or Gnosis as a result of Gooshy Gooze. A character cannot be equipped with more than 1 Gooshy Gooze.
